ATSC 113.title: Weather Science for Sailing, Flying, and Snow Sports
ATSC 113.description: Atmospheric-science principles elucidated by case studies applied to sailing, soaring, flying and snow sports.

ATSC 201.title: Meteorology of Storms
ATSC 201.description: Characteristics and physical processes of thunderstorms, tornadoes, lightning, hail, hurricanes, blizzards, cyclones and other storms. Recommended pre-requisite: completion of first-year science.

ATSC 212.title: Earth and Atmospheric Science Introductory Computing Laboratory
ATSC 212.description: Computing tools, including Unix/Linux, Web page creation, programming languages used for numerical calculation, database programs. Recommended pre-requisites: one of CPSC 103, CPSC 110.

ATSC 301.title: Atmospheric Radiation and Remote Sensing
ATSC 301.description: Energy transfer at infrared, visible, and microwave wavelengths. Analysis of satellite measurements of the atmosphere and surface.
ATSC 301.prerequisiteText: One of PHYS 102, PHYS 108, PHYS 118, PHYS 158. and familiarity with a programming language

ATSC 303.title: Methods in Atmospheric Science
ATSC 303.description: An introduction to instrumentation used in monitoring the state of the atmosphere; a brief survey of methods of analysis of meteorological data.
ATSC 303.prerequisiteText: One of EOSC 211, CPSC 103, CPSC 110 and one of ATSC 201, GEOB 200, GEOS 200

ATSC 313.title: Renewable Energy Meteorology
ATSC 313.description: The meteorology of hydro, wind, and solar power. Atmospheric processes affecting renewable energy on global, regional & local weather scales.
ATSC 313.prerequisiteText: One of MATH 101, MATH 103, MATH 105, MATH 121 and one of PHYS 101, PHYS 106, PHYS 107, PHYS 117, PHYS 131, PHYS 157 and one of APSC 160, CPSC 103, CPSC 110, DSCI 100, EOSC 211

ATSC 398.title: Co-operative Work Placement I
ATSC 398.description: Approved and supervised technical work experience in an industrial, university or government setting for a minimum of 14 weeks. Normally taken in the Winter Session (Term 2) in third year. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to Co-operative Education Program in Atmospheric Science.
ATSC 398.prerequisiteText: ATSC_V 201 and one of GEOB_V 300, GEOS_V 300

ATSC 399.title: Co-operative Work Placement II
ATSC 399.description: Approved and supervised technical work experience in an industrial, university or government setting for a minimum of 14 weeks. Normally taken in the Summer Session (Terms 1 and 2) following third year. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-operative Education Program in Atmospheric Science.

ATSC 404.title: Dynamic Meteorology
ATSC 404.description: Dynamic principles governing atmospheric motions on a rotating planet. Simplified mathematical models of atmospheric flow based on scale analysis. Application to synoptic-scale and general circulation of the troposphere.
ATSC 404.prerequisiteText: One of EOSC 352, MATH 316, PHYS 312 and one of EOSC 250, MATH 217, MATH 317

ATSC 405.title: Cloud Physics and Chemistry
ATSC 405.description: Cloud thermodynamics, chemistry and microphysics. Computer modelling of droplet growth, convection, and mixing. Application of differential equations to atmospheric problems.

children.raw: Familiarity with a programming language is required

ATSC 405.prerequisiteText: MATH 215. Familiarity with a programming language is required

ATSC 409.title: Numerical Techniques for Ocean, Atmosphere and Earth Scientists
ATSC 409.description: Web-based introduction to the practical numerical solution of ordinary and partial differential equations including considerations of stability and accuracy.

children.raw: Familiarity with a programming language is required

ATSC 409.prerequisiteText: One of MATH 215, MATH 255, MATH 256, MATH 265. Familiarity with a programming language is required

ATSC 413.title: Forest-fire Weather and Climate
ATSC 413.description: Synoptic and mesoscale meteorology and weather forecasting applied to wildfires. Effect of weather on fire behaviour, danger, smoke, climate and sustainability at the urban-forest interface.

ATSC 448.title: Directed Studies
ATSC 448.description: Investigation of a topic to be agreed upon by a member of the faculty and the student. Permission of the undergraduate advisor and of the supervising faculty member is required before registration.

ATSC 449.title: Honours Project
ATSC 449.description: Honours students must submit a graduating report based on a project undertaken with the approval of the Associate Chair of the Atmospheric Science Program.

ATSC 490.title: Student Directed Seminars in Atmospheric Science
ATSC 490.description: Self-directed, collaborative studies in atmospheric science, in a group-learning environment, initiated and coordinated by senior undergraduate students with the supervision of a faculty advisor. Course structure, enrolment, and delivery methods will comply with the Handbook for Student Directed Seminars.

ATSC 498.title: Co-operative Work Placement III
ATSC 498.description: Approved and supervised technical work experience in an industrial, university or government setting for a minimum of 14 weeks. Normally taken in the Summer Session (Terms 1 and 2) after fourth year. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-operative Education Program in Atmospheric Science.
ATSC 498.prerequisiteText: ATSC_V 399 and one of ATSC_V 303, GEOB_V 304, GEOS_V 304

ATSC 499.title: Co-operative Work Placement IV
ATSC 499.description: Approved and supervised technical work experience in an industrial, university or government setting for a minimum of 14 weeks. Normally taken in Winter Session (Term 1) of the fifth year. Technical report required. Restricted to students admitted to the Co-operative Education Program in Atmospheric Science.

ATSC 500.title: Boundary-Layer Meteorology
ATSC 500.description: Theoretical and empirical analysis of the atmospheric boundary layer with particular emphasis on energy and mass exchanges near the Earth's surface.

ATSC 506.title: Numerical Techniques for Ocean, Atmosphere and Earth Scientists

ATSC 507.title: Numerical Weather Prediction

prerequisite.raw: a fluid-dynamics course, a numerical-methods course, as well as computer-programming skills

ATSC 507.prerequisiteText: All of a fluid-dynamics course, a numerical-methods course, as well as computer-programming skills

ATSC 597.title: Co-operative Work Placement I
ATSC 597.description: Restricted to students admitted to the M.Sc. Co-operative Education Option in Atmospheric Science.

ATSC 598.title: Co-operative Work Placement II
ATSC 598.description: Restricted to students admitted to the M.Sc. Co-operative Education Option in Atmospheric Science.
